quantity: predicted interval-mean incident radiant flux at upward-facing cell-center receivers
scope: conditional reconstructed-arrival and physical-parameter scenario; not measured heat

crop.selection: all currently burned cells and all q>0 cells, plus margin
crop.calculation_scope: full source and receiver grid before cropping

inference_assumptions.boundary: zero exterior burned sources and environmental context
inference_assumptions.probability_coverage: all 7519 source cells resolved under the explicit inference scenario
inference_assumptions.arrival_scope: only known currently burned cells; future arrivals excluded from new-burn inference

physical_assumptions.dry_fuel: static FCCS reference loading, coverage-weighted with explicit fallback
physical_assumptions.point_residence: FBFM40 reference duration with explicit fallback SAV=2000 ft^-1 for unsupported/nonburnable classes
physical_assumptions.cell_duration: straight-front cell crossing time plus local point residence; fixed phase energy redistributed over this cell window
physical_assumptions.arrival_interpretation: supplied reconstructed cell arrival retained as cell burn-start/first-entry scenario; no center-time shift applied
physical_assumptions.nonburnable_class_scope: fallback duration is a scenario; it does not establish combustible fuel

fuel_reference_provenance.physical_definition: reference dry fuelbed loading, not measured event-date available fuel
fuel_reference_provenance.partial_coverage_policy: retain mapped-part mean; reject as whole-cell combustion input unless explicit fallback is supplied
fuel_reference_provenance.fallback_policy: caller loading describes unmapped fraction: coverage*mapped_mean + (1-coverage)*fallback; unreadable mapped mean or coverage uses fallback for entire cell
fuel_reference_provenance.zero_bound_policy: zero for unknown data is a nonnegative mathematical lower bound, not an observed or assumed zero fuel load
fuel_reference_provenance.ecological_limitations: no automatic biome-to-mass, canopy-to-mass, or moisture damping; consumption fraction, heat yield and duration remain caller assumptions

cell_burning_duration_provenance.equation: T_cell = (abs(n dot u) + abs(n dot v)) / spread_rate_m_s + T_point
cell_burning_duration_provenance.equation_origin: geometric projection of affine-cell vertices; explicit package model assumption
cell_burning_duration_provenance.meaning: whole-cell emission duration from first front entry until last-point front flame extinction

point_residence_time.equation: sigma_ft_inv = sum(load * particle_sav_ft_inv**2) / sum(load * particle_sav_ft_inv); duration_s = 384 * 60 / sigma_ft_inv
point_residence_time.meaning: point-scale passing surface-fire flaming-front residence time
limitations: excludes indefinite trailing burning and smouldering
assumes no fuel-bed packing effect
does not determine coarse-cell traversal time or subcell flame positions
does not establish arrival time or an active-flame observation

default_spread_rate_reference.reported_statistic: median reconstructed forward rate of spread
default_spread_rate_reference.population: spread observations from 80 large mainland Portuguese wildfires, 2015-2021
default_spread_rate_reference.scope: reference scenario; not a universal speed or a Fish Creek measurement

cell_burning_duration_provenance.direction_convention: counterclockwise degrees from projected +x; advancing front normal; not wind bearing
cell_burning_duration_provenance.front_assumption: straight front with constant normal direction and positive constant speed within each cell
cell_burning_duration_provenance.arrival_semantics: first cell entry/burn start; supplied arrivals are not interpreted as center arrivals
cell_burning_duration_provenance.emission_profile: uniform whole-cell rectangular pulse on [arrival, arrival + T_cell)
cell_burning_duration_provenance.energy_policy: fixed supplied phase-consumed mass times heat yield; conditional HRR divided by T_cell; total phase energy preserved

sources.supported_role: defines residence as front flaming time at a stationary fuel point; does not provide cell crossing duration
distinguishes post-frontal flaming and smoldering combustion from perimeter spread; does not supply this geometric crossing law

limitations: spread speed and direction are explicit supplied scenarios, not inferred observations
cell occupancy duration differs from point flame residence
uniform rectangular emission does not resolve time-varying burning fraction or moving subcell flame geometry
no automatic trailing, smoldering, reignition, or crown-combustion extension
reconstructed arrival data do not establish actual first-cell-entry time

input_provenance.scenario: reported median reference or explicit speed override; not Fish Creek calibration

heat_metadata.heat_flux_semantics: interval-mean incident radiant flux in W/m2
heat_metadata.dose_semantics: integral of interval-mean radiant flux over forecast interval in J/m2
heat_metadata.scope: newly igniting cells plus existing burning under supplied arrival and duration scenario
heat_metadata.arrival_time_assumption: conditional on a first-new-burning event, arrival is uniform within the hour
heat_metadata.ignition_rate_source: uniform conditional initiation supplied as an additional scenario
heat_metadata.burning_profile_assumption: constant conditional HRR for the supplied residence duration after arrival
heat_metadata.present_burning_assumption: activity inferred from past arrival and supplied duration on known already-burned cells
heat_metadata.activity_interval: [arrival_time_s, arrival_time_s + burning_duration_s); inactive at exact extinction
heat_metadata.unknown_probability_policy: full expectation is NaN when emitting-source activity is unresolved; nonnegative-source endpoints yield bounds
heat_metadata.unknown_current_age_policy: remaining duration in [0,T]; mean occupancy upper min(T/D,1); endpoint upper 1 if T>D, otherwise 0
heat_metadata.bounds_scope: fixed supplied combustion, duration, geometry, and finite source domain; existing fire restricted to known already-burned support; excludes existing fire hidden by unknown cumulative state, omitted transport and parameter uncertainty
